model.indimesh_dbt_core_reference.dim_cu.raw_code:
{{
    config(
        post_hook = '{{  indicium_dbt_utils.apply_column_mask() }}'
    )
}}

with
    customers as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('tru_customer') }}
    )

    , get_one_customer_per_row as (
        select
            customer_id
            , account_number
            , store_id
            , person_full_name
            , email_address
            , max(
                case
                    when phone_number_type = 'Home'
                        then phone_number
                end
            ) as home_phone_number
            , max(
                case
                    when phone_number_type = 'Work'
                        then phone_number
                end
            ) as work_phone_number
            , max(
                case
                    when phone_number_type = 'Cell'
                        then phone_number
                end
            ) as cell_phone_number
            , max(
                case
                    when address_type_name = 'Home'
                        then city
                end
            ) as home_city
            , max(
                case
                    when address_type_name = 'Shipping'
                        then city
                end
            ) as shipping_city
            , max(
                case
                    when address_type_name = 'Shipping'
                        then territory_name
                end
            ) as shipping_territory_name
            , max(
                case
                    when address_type_name = 'Home'
                        then territory_name
                end
            ) as home_territory_name
            , max(
                case
                    when address_type_name = 'Home'
                        then country_region_name
                end
            ) as home_country_region_name
            , max(
                case
                    when address_type_name = 'Shipping'
                        then country_region_name
                end
            ) as shipping_country_region_name
            , max(updated_at) as updated_at
            -- This cast is necessary to match the exact type of contract
            , cast(current_timestamp() as timestamp) as loaded_at
        from customers
        group by
            customer_id
            , account_number
            , store_id
            , person_full_name
            , email_address
    )

    , add_surrogate_key as (
        select
            {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key(['customer_id']) }} as customer_sk
            , *
        from get_one_customer_per_row
    )

select *
from add_surrogate_key

model.indimesh_dbt_core_reference.fct_sa.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental'
    , incremental_strategy="merge"
    , unique_key='sales_order_sk'
    , on_schema_change='fail'
) }} -- You can use 'enable=false' to disable the incremental model.

with
    orders as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('tru_order') }}
        {% if is_incremental() %}
        where extracted_at in ({{ var('partitions_to_replace') | join (', ') }})
        {% endif %}
    )

    , products as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_products') }}
    )

    , shipping as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_shipping') }}
    )

    , customers as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_customers') }}
    )

    , offers as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_sales_offers') }}
    )

    , employee as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_employees') }}
    )

    , stores as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_stores') }}
    )

    , add_sales_metrics as (
        select
            orders.sales_order_id
            , orders.sales_order_detail_id
            , orders.product_id
            , orders.special_offer_id
            , orders.customer_id
            , orders.sales_person_id
            , orders.territory_id
            , orders.ship_method_id
            , orders.credit_card_id
            , orders.currency_rate_id
            , orders.carrier_tracking_number
            , orders.revision_number
            , orders.order_date
            , orders.due_date
            , orders.ship_date
            , {{ indicium_dbt_utils.crossdb_datediff('orders.order_date', 'orders.ship_date') }} as order_processing_time
            , {{ indicium_dbt_utils.crossdb_datediff('orders.ship_date', 'orders.due_date') }} as shipping_time
            , orders.order_status
            , orders.online_order_flag
            , orders.sales_order_number
            , orders.purchase_order_number
            , orders.account_number
            , orders.customer_bill_to_address_id
            , orders.customer_ship_to_address_id
            , orders.credit_card_approval_code
            , orders.order_qty
            , orders.unit_price
            , orders.unit_price_discount
            , orders.subtotal
            , orders.tax_amount
            , orders.freight

with
    employee_pay_history as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('tru_employee_pay_history') }}
    )

    , dates as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_dates') }}
    )

    , employee as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_employees') }}
    )

    , get_distinct_ids_from_pay_history as (
        select distinct employee_pay_history.business_entity_id
        from employee_pay_history
    )

    , get_shift_period as (
        select
            get_distinct_ids_from_pay_history.business_entity_id
            , employee.working_hours
            , employee.employee_sk as employee_fk
        from get_distinct_ids_from_pay_history
        left join employee
            on get_distinct_ids_from_pay_history.business_entity_id = employee.business_entity_id
    )

    , open_ids_with_dates as (
        select
            get_shift_period.business_entity_id
            , dates.date_day
            , get_shift_period.working_hours
            , get_shift_period.employee_fk
        from get_shift_period
        cross join dates
    )

    , put_all_info_together as (
        select
            open_ids_with_dates.business_entity_id
            , open_ids_with_dates.employee_fk
            , open_ids_with_dates.date_day
            , open_ids_with_dates.working_hours
            , employee_pay_history.rate_change_date
            , employee_pay_history.hourly_rate
            , employee_pay_history.pay_frequency
            , employee_pay_history.updated_at
        from open_ids_with_dates
        left join employee_pay_history
            on open_ids_with_dates.business_entity_id = employee_pay_history.business_entity_id
            and open_ids_with_dates.date_day = employee_pay_history.rate_change_date
        where
            open_ids_with_dates.date_day between
            (select min(rate_change_date) from employee_pay_history)
            and (select max(rate_change_date) from employee_pay_history)
    )

    , fill_with_historical_data as (
        select
            business_entity_id
            , date_day
            , employee_fk
            , {{ indicium_dbt_utils.crossdb_last_value('working_hours') }} over (
                partition by business_entity_id
                order by date_day
                rows between unbounded preceding and current row
            ) as working_hours
            , {{ indicium_dbt_utils.crossdb_last_value('rate_change_date') }} over (
                partition by business_entity_id
                order by date_day
                rows between unbounded preceding and current row
            ) as rate_change_date
            , {{ indicium_dbt_utils.crossdb_last_value('hourly_rate') }} over (
                partition by business_entity_id
                order by date_day
                rows between unbounded preceding and current row
            ) as hourly_rate
            , {{ indicium_dbt_utils.crossdb_last_value('pay_frequency') }} over (
                partition by business_entity_id
                order by date_day
                rows between unbounded preceding and current row
            ) as pay_frequency
            , {{ indicium_dbt_utils.crossdb_last_value('updated_at') }} over (

            , purchasing.stocked_qty
            , purchasing.order_qty
            , purchasing.unit_price
            , purchasing.line_total
            , purchasing.tax_amt
            , purchasing.freight
            , (purchasing.line_total + purchasing.tax_amt + purchasing.freight) as total_due_per_product
            , purchasing.updated_at

        select

            , add_procurement_metrics.purchase_order_id
            , products.product_sk as product_fk
            , shipping.shipping_method_sk as shipping_method_fk
            , suppliers.supplier_sk as supplier_fk
            , employee.employee_sk as employee_fk
            , add_procurement_metrics.due_date
            , add_procurement_metrics.order_date
            , add_procurement_metrics.ship_date
            , add_procurement_metrics.days_expected_to_receive
            , add_procurement_metrics.estimated_shipment
            , add_procurement_metrics.purchase_order_status
            , add_procurement_metrics.received_qty
            , add_procurement_metrics.rejected_qty
            , add_procurement_metrics.stocked_qty
            , add_procurement_metrics.order_qty
            , add_procurement_metrics.unit_price
            , add_procurement_metrics.line_total
            , add_procurement_metrics.tax_amt
            , add_procurement_metrics.freight
            , add_procurement_metrics.total_due_per_product
            , add_procurement_metrics.updated_at
            -- This cast is necessary to match the exact type of contract
            , cast(current_timestamp() as timestamp) as loaded_at
        from add_procurement_metrics
        left join products
            on add_procurement_metrics.product_id = products.product_id
        left join shipping
            on add_procurement_metrics.ship_method_id = shipping.ship_method_id
        left join suppliers
            on add_procurement_metrics.vendor_id = suppliers.business_entity_id
        left join employee
            on add_procurement_metrics.employee_id = employee.business_entity_id
    )

    , add_surrogate_key as (
        select
            md5(cast(concat(coalesce(cast(join_to_get_fk.purchase_order_detail_id as string), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_')) as string)) as purchasing_order_sk
            , *

        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_warehouses_databricks') }}
    )

    , clusters as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_clusters_databricks') }}
    )

    , final_joins as (
        select
            -- Ids
            tru_costs.record_id
            , warehouses.warehouse_sk as warehouse_fk
            , warehouses.warehouse_id
            , clusters.cluster_id
            , clusters.cluster_sk as cluster_fk
            , tru_costs.job_run_id
            , tru_costs.job_id
            , tru_costs.notebook_id
            , tru_costs.endpoint_id
            , tru_costs.app_id
            , tru_costs.dlt_pipeline_id
            , tru_costs.dlt_update_id
            , tru_costs.dlt_maintenance_id
            , tru_costs.workspace_id
            , tru_costs.account_id
            -- Informations
            , tru_costs.sku_name
            , tru_costs.cloud
            , tru_costs.record_type
            , tru_costs.billing_origin_product
            , tru_costs.usage_type
            , case
                when clusters.cluster_name is not null
                    then clusters.cluster_name
                when warehouses.warehouse_name is not null
                    then warehouses.warehouse_name
                when tru_costs.cluster_id is not null
                    then tru_costs.cluster_id
                when tru_costs.warehouse_id is not null
                    then tru_costs.warehouse_id
                when tru_costs.usage_unit = 'GB'
                    then 'Internet'
                when tru_costs.sku_name like '%SERVERLESS%'
                    then 'Serverless'
            end as cluster_name
            -- Identity metadata
            , tru_costs.run_as
            , tru_costs.created_by
            , tru_costs.owned_by
            -- Usage metadata
            , tru_costs.node_type
            , tru_costs.endpoint_name
            , tru_costs.job_name
            -- Product Features and Custom Tags
            , tru_costs.is_serverless
            , tru_costs.env
            -- Values and Calculations
            , tru_costs.usage_unit
            , tru_costs.usage_quantity
            , tru_costs.default_price
            , tru_costs.promotional_price
            , tru_costs.effective_price
            , tru_costs.total_cost
            , tru_costs.simple_projection_cost
            -- Dates
            , tru_costs.usage_date
            , tru_costs.usage_start_time
            , tru_costs.usage_end_time
            , tru_costs.ingestion_date
            -- Extras
            , tru_costs._loaded_at
            , tru_costs._system_name
        from tru_costs
        left join warehouses
            on tru_costs.warehouse_id = warehouses.warehouse_id
        left join clusters
            on tru_costs.cluster_id = clusters.cluster_id
    )

    , create_surrogate_key as (
        select
            {{ dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key([
                'record_id'
            ]) }} as costs_sk
            , *
        from final_joins
    )

select *
from create_surrogate_key

        from {{ ref('fct_job_run_databricks') }}
        qualify row_number() over (
            partition by run_id
            order by period_start_time desc

with
    run_results as (
        /* Extract run results from the staging table */
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_dbt_run_results_databricks') }}
    )

    , invocation_details as (
        /* Extract invocations data from the staging table */
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_dbt_invocations_databricks') }}
    )

    , enriched_execution_data as (
        /* Join run results with invocations to enrich run data with invocation-related information */
        select
            run_results.model_execution_id
            , run_results.unique_id
            , run_results.invocation_id
            , run_results.last_updated
            , run_results.resource_name
            , run_results.log_message
            , run_results.run_status
            , run_results.resource_type
            , run_results.execution_time
            , run_results.execute_started_at
            , run_results.execute_completed_at
            , run_results.compile_started_at
            , run_results.compile_completed_at
            , run_results.rows_affected
            , run_results.is_full_refresh
            , run_results.compiled_code
            , run_results.failures
            , run_results.query_id
            , run_results.thread_id
            , run_results.materialization
            , run_results.adapter_response
            , invocations.job_id
            , invocations.job_name
            , invocations.job_run_id
            , invocations.run_started_at
            , invocations.run_completed_at
            , invocations.created_at
            , invocations.command
            , invocations.dbt_version
            , invocations.elementary_version
            , invocations.invocation_vars
            , invocations.vars
            , invocations.target_name
            , invocations.target_database
            , invocations.target_schema
            , invocations.target_profile_name
            , invocations.threads
            , invocations.selected
            , invocations.yaml_selector
            , invocations.project_id as dbt_project_id
            , invocations.project_name
            , invocations.env
            , invocations.env_id
            , invocations.cause_category
            , invocations.cause
            , invocations.pull_request_id
            , invocations.git_sha
            , invocations.orchestrator
            , invocations.dbt_user
            , invocations.job_url
            , invocations.job_run_url
            , invocations.account_id
            , run_results._loaded_at
            , run_results._system_name
            -- Calculate execution times and derive last execution and last success flags
            , round((run_results.execution_time / 60), 3) as execution_time_min
            , coalesce(run_results.execute_started_at, invocations.run_started_at) as consolidated_started_at
            , row_number() over (
                partition by run_results.resource_name
                order by coalesce(
                    run_results.execute_started_at
                    , invocations.run_started_at
                ) desc
            ) as last_execution_index
            , row_number() over (
                partition by run_results.resource_name, run_results.run_status
                order by coalesce(
                    run_results.execute_started_at
                    , invocations.run_started_at
                ) desc
            ) as last_execution_success_index
        from run_results
        left join invocation_details as invocations
            on run_results.invocation_id = invocations.invocation_id
    )

    , execution_flags as (
        /* Add additional flags and extract relevant date truncations for the analysis */
        select
            *
            , cast(last_updated as date) as last_updated_date
            , coalesce(last_execution_index = 1, false) as is_last_execution
            , case
                when
                    last_execution_index = 1
                    and consolidated_started_at >= dateadd(day, -7, current_timestamp())
                    then true
                when last_execution_index != 1
                    then null
                else
                    false
            end as is_execution_last_seven_days
            , coalesce(last_execution_success_index = 1 and run_status = 'success', false)
            as is_last_success_execution
            , case
                when materialization = 'table'
                    then 'full'
                when
                    materialization = 'incremental'
                    and is_full_refresh = true
                    then 'full'
                when
                    materialization = 'incremental'
                    and is_full_refresh = false
                    then 'incremental'
                else
                    'unknown'
            end as load_type
        from enriched_execution_data
    )

select *
from execution_flags

model.indimesh_dbt_core_reference.tru_co.raw_code:
with  --noqa: disable=LT02
    usage as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_usage_databricks') }}
    )

    , prices as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_prices_databricks') }}
    )

    , get_pricing_info as (
        select
            -- Ids
            usage.record_id
            , usage.workspace_id
            , usage.account_id
            , usage.warehouse_id
            , usage.cluster_id
            , usage.job_run_id
            , usage.job_id
            , usage.notebook_id
            , usage.app_id
            , usage.dlt_pipeline_id
            , usage.dlt_update_id
            , usage.dlt_maintenance_id
            , usage.endpoint_id
            -- Informations
            , usage.sku_name
            , usage.cloud
            , usage.record_type
            , usage.billing_origin_product
            , usage.usage_type
            -- Identity Metadata
            , usage.run_as
            , usage.owned_by
            , usage.created_by
            -- Usage Metadata
            , usage.node_type
            , usage.endpoint_name
            , usage.job_name
            -- Product Features and Custom Tags
            , usage.is_serverless
            , usage.env
            -- Values
            , usage.usage_unit
            , usage.usage_quantity
            -- Calculations
            , prices.default_unit_price as default_price
            , prices.promotional_unit_price as promotional_price
            , prices.effective_unit_price as effective_price
            , (usage.usage_quantity * prices.effective_unit_price) as total_cost
            , case
                when (
                    current_date() = last_day(current_date())
                    and month(current_date()) = month(last_day(current_date()))
                 ) then (usage.usage_quantity * prices.effective_unit_price)
                else (
                    (usage.usage_quantity * prices.effective_unit_price)
                    / day(current_date())
                ) * day(last_day(current_date()))
            end as simple_projection_cost
            -- Dates
            , usage.usage_date
            , usage.usage_start_time
            , usage.usage_end_time
            , usage.ingestion_date
            -- Extras
            , usage._loaded_at
            , usage._system_name
        from usage
        left join prices
            on usage.cloud = prices.cloud
            and usage.sku_name = prices.sku_name
            and usage.usage_start_time >= prices.price_start_time
            and (
                usage.usage_start_time < prices.price_end_time
                or prices.price_end_time is null
            )
    )

select *
from get_pricing_info

model.indimesh_dbt_core_reference.obt_da.raw_code:
with
    sales as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_sales_orders') }}
    )

    , purchase as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_purchasing_orders') }}
    )

    , stores as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_stores') }}
    )

    , dates as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_dates') }}
    )

    , products as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_products') }}
    )

    , suppliers as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('dim_suppliers') }}
    )

    , customers as (
        select *
        from {{ ref("dim_customers") }}
    )

    , get_purchase_and_sales_metrics as (
        select
            sales.sales_order_sk
            , sales.store_fk
            , sales.customer_fk
            , purchase.product_fk
            , purchase.supplier_fk
            , dates.date_day
            , sales.online_order_flag
            , purchase.updated_at
            , sum(purchase.order_qty) as purchase_order_qty
            , sum(purchase.received_qty) as purchasing_received_qty
            , sum(purchase.rejected_qty) as purchasing_rejected_qty
            , sum(purchase.stocked_qty) as purchasing_stocked_qty
            , sum(purchase.total_due_per_product) as purchasing_cost
            , sum(sales.order_qty) as sales_order_qty
            , sum(sales.revenue) as sales_revenue
            , sum(purchase.stocked_qty) - sum(sales.order_qty) as inventory_balance
        from dates
        left join sales
            on dates.date_day = sales.order_date
        left join purchase
            on dates.date_day = purchase.order_date
        where
            purchase.ship_date is not null
            and sales.ship_date is not null
        group by
            sales.sales_order_sk
            , sales.store_fk
            , sales.customer_fk
            , purchase.product_fk
            , purchase.supplier_fk
            , dates.date_day
            , sales.online_order_flag
            , purchase.updated_at
    )

    , get_purchase_and_sales_infos as (
        select
            get_purchase_and_sales_metrics.sales_order_sk
            , products.product_name
            , coalesce(products.category_description, 'Not Applied') as category_description
            , coalesce(products.subcategory_description, 'Not Applied') as subcategory_description
            , coalesce(products.product_line, 'Not Applied') as product_line
            , coalesce(products.product_class, 'Not Applied') as product_class
            , coalesce(products.product_style, 'Not Applied') as product_style
            , suppliers.vendor_company_name
            , suppliers.country_region_name as vendor_country
            , suppliers.territory_name as vendor_territory_name
            , case
                when get_purchase_and_sales_metrics.online_order_flag then 'Online Sell'
                else stores.store_name

{{ config(
    materialized='incremental'
    , incremental_strategy="merge"
    , unique_key='purchase_order_detail_id'
    , on_schema_change='fail'
) }}

with
    purchasing_order as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__purchase_order_header') }}
        {% if is_incremental() %}
        where extracted_at in ({{ var('partitions_to_replace') | join (', ') }})
        {% endif %}
    )

    , purchasing_order_detail as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__purchase_order_detail') }}
        {% if is_incremental() %}
        where extracted_at in ({{ var('partitions_to_replace') | join (', ') }})
        {% endif %}
    )

    , detailed_purchasing_orders as (
        /*
        This CTE makes the distribution of the purchase freight and tax amounts.
        The intention here is to have one general table to all orders.
        Since the freight and the tax are values applied to the order itself, we split these values to the product level.
        */
        select
            purchasing_order_detail.purchase_order_id
            , purchasing_order_detail.purchase_order_detail_id
            , purchasing_order_detail.due_date
            , purchasing_order_detail.order_qty
            , purchasing_order_detail.product_id
            , purchasing_order_detail.unit_price
            , purchasing_order_detail.line_total
            , purchasing_order_detail.received_qty
            , purchasing_order_detail.rejected_qty
            , purchasing_order_detail.stocked_qty
            , purchasing_order.purchase_order_status
            , purchasing_order.employee_id
            , purchasing_order.vendor_id
            , purchasing_order.ship_method_id
            , purchasing_order.order_date
            , purchasing_order.ship_date
            , purchasing_order.tax_amt / count(purchasing_order_detail.purchase_order_id) over (
                partition by purchasing_order_detail.purchase_order_id
                order by purchasing_order_detail.purchase_order_id
            ) as tax_amt
            , purchasing_order.freight / count(purchasing_order_detail.purchase_order_id) over (
                partition by purchasing_order_detail.purchase_order_id
                order by purchasing_order_detail.purchase_order_id
            ) as freight
            , purchasing_order_detail.updated_at
            , purchasing_order_detail.extracted_at
            -- This cast is necessary to match the exact type of contract
            , cast(current_timestamp() as timestamp) as loaded_at
            , purchasing_order_detail.system_name
        from purchasing_order_detail
        left join purchasing_order
            on purchasing_order_detail.purchase_order_id = purchasing_order.purchase_order_id
    )

select *
from detailed_purchasing_orders

with
    employee as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__employee') }}
    )

    , department as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__department') }}
    )

    , department_history as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__employee_department_history') }}
    )

    , shift as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__shift') }}
    )

    , address_type as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__address_type') }}
    )

    , address as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__address') }}
    )

    , business_entity_address as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__business_entity_address') }}
    )

    , business_entity_contact as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__business_entity_contact') }}
    )

    , business_entity as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__business_entity') }}
    )

    , contact_type as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__contact_type') }}
    )

    , country_region as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__country_region') }}
    )

    , email_address as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__email_address') }}
    )

    , person_phone as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__person_phone') }}
    )

    , person_phone_type as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__phone_number_type') }}
    )

    , person as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__person') }}
    )

    , state_province as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__state_province') }}
    )

    , sales_person as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__salesperson') }}
    )

    , employee_department_and_shift_info as (
        select
            employee.business_entity_id
            , employee.national_id_number
            , employee.login_id
            , employee.job_title
            , employee.birth_date
            , employee.marital_status
            , employee.gender
            , employee.hire_date
            , employee.salaried_flag
            , employee.vacation_hours
            , employee.sick_leave_hours
            , employee.current_flag
            , employee.organization_node
            , employee.organization_level
            , department.department_name
            , department.department_group
            , shift.shift_period
            , shift.shift_start_time
            , shift.shift_end_time
            , department_history.work_start_date as department_work_start_date
            , department_history.work_end_date as department_work_end_date
            , sales_person.sales_quota
            , sales_person.bonus
            , sales_person.commission_pct
            , sales_person.sales_ytd
            , sales_person.sales_last_year
            , employee.updated_at
            , employee.extracted_at
            -- This cast is necessary to match the exact type of contract
            , cast(current_timestamp() as timestamp) as loaded_at
            , employee.system_name
        from employee
        left join department_history
            on employee.business_entity_id = department_history.business_entity_id
        left join department
            on department_history.department_id = department.department_id
        left join shift
            on department_history.shift_id = shift.shift_id
        left join sales_person
            on employee.business_entity_id = sales_person.business_entity_id
    )

    , person_informations as (
        select
            person.business_entity_id
            , person.person_type
            , person.name_style
            , person.person_title
            , person.person_first_name
            , person.person_middle_name
            , person.person_last_name
            , person.person_full_name
            , person.person_suffix
            , person.email_promotion
            , person.additional_contact_info
            , contact_type.contact_name
            , email_address.email_address
            , person_phone_type.phone_number_type
            , person_phone.phone_number
            , address.address_line_1
            , address.address_line_2
            , address_type.address_type_name
            , address.city
            , address.postal_code
            , country_region.country_region_name
            , state_province.state_province_code
            , state_province.country_region_code
            , state_province.territory_name
        from person
        left join business_entity
            on person.business_entity_id = business_entity.business_entity_id
        left join business_entity_address
            on business_entity.business_entity_id = business_entity_address.business_entity_id
        left join address_type
            on business_entity_address.address_type_id = address_type.address_type_id
        left join address
            on business_entity_address.address_id = address.address_id
        left join business_entity_contact
            on business_entity.business_entity_id = business_entity_contact.business_entity_id
        left join contact_type
            on business_entity_contact.contact_type_id = contact_type.contact_type_id
        left join state_province
            on address.state_province_id = state_province.state_province_id
        left join country_region
            on state_province.country_region_code = country_region.country_region_code
        left join email_address
            on person.business_entity_id = email_address.business_entity_id
        left join person_phone
            on person.business_entity_id = person_phone.business_entity_id
        left join person_phone_type
            on person_phone.phone_number_type_id = person_phone_type.phone_number_type_id
    )

    , join_employee_with_personal_info as (
        select
            employee.business_entity_id
            , employee.national_id_number
            , employee.login_id

model.indimesh_dbt_core_reference.tru_cu.raw_code:
with
    customers as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__customer') }}
    )

    , address_type as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__address_type') }}
    )

    , address as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__address') }}
    )

    , business_entity_address as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__business_entity_address') }}
    )

    , business_entity_contact as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__business_entity_contact') }}
    )

    , business_entity as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__business_entity') }}
    )

    , contact_type as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__contact_type') }}
    )

    , country_region as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__country_region') }}
    )

    , email_address as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__email_address') }}
    )

    , person_phone as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__person_phone') }}
    )

    , person_phone_type as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__phone_number_type') }}
    )

    , state_province as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__state_province') }}
    )

    , person as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__person') }}
    )

    , sales_territory as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__sales_territory') }}
    )

    , store as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__store') }}
    )

    , customers_with_personal_info as (
        select
            customers.customer_id
            , customers.account_number
            , customers.store_id
            , coalesce(store.store_name, 'not registered') as store_name
            , coalesce(sales_territory.territory_name, 'not registered') as sales_territory_name
            , person.name_style
            , coalesce(person.person_title, 'not registered') as person_title
            , coalesce(person.person_first_name, 'not registered') as person_first_name
            , coalesce(person.person_middle_name, 'not registered') as person_middle_name
            , coalesce(person.person_last_name, 'not registered') as person_last_name
            , coalesce(person.person_full_name, 'not registered') as person_full_name
            , coalesce(contact_type.contact_name, 'not registered') as contact_name
            , coalesce(email_address.email_address, 'not registered') as email_address
            , coalesce(person_phone_type.phone_number_type, 'not registered') as phone_number_type
            , coalesce(person_phone.phone_number, 'not registered') as phone_number
            , coalesce(address.address_line_1, 'not registered') as address_line_1
            , coalesce(address.address_line_2, 'not registered') as address_line_2
            , coalesce(address_type.address_type_name, 'not registered') as address_type_name
            , coalesce(address.city, 'not registered') as city
            , coalesce(address.postal_code, 'not registered') as postal_code
            , coalesce(country_region.country_region_name, 'not registered') as country_region_name
            , coalesce(state_province.state_province_code, 'not registered') as state_province_code
            , coalesce(state_province.country_region_code, 'not registered') as country_region_code
            , coalesce(state_province.territory_name, 'not registered') as territory_name
            , customers.updated_at
            , customers.extracted_at
            -- This cast is necessary to match the exact type of contract
            , cast(current_timestamp() as timestamp) as loaded_at
            , customers.system_name
        from customers
        left join person
            on customers.person_id = person.business_entity_id
        left join business_entity_contact
            on person.business_entity_id = business_entity_contact.person_id
        left join contact_type
            on business_entity_contact.contact_type_id = contact_type.contact_type_id
        left join email_address
            on person.business_entity_id = email_address.business_entity_id
        left join person_phone
            on person.business_entity_id = person_phone.business_entity_id
        left join person_phone_type
            on person_phone.phone_number_type_id = person_phone_type.phone_number_type_id
        left join business_entity
            on person.business_entity_id = business_entity.business_entity_id
        left join business_entity_address
            on business_entity.business_entity_id = business_entity_address.business_entity_id
        left join address_type
            on business_entity_address.address_type_id = address_type.address_type_id
        left join address
            on business_entity_address.address_id = address.address_id
        left join state_province
            on address.state_province_id = state_province.state_province_id
        left join country_region
            on state_province.country_region_code = country_region.country_region_code
        left join sales_territory
            on customers.territory_id = sales_territory.territory_id
        left join store
            on customers.store_id = store.store_id
    )

select *
from customers_with_personal_info

model.indimesh_dbt_core_reference.tru_or.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='incremental'
    , incremental_strategy="merge"
    , unique_key='sales_order_detail_id'
    , on_schema_change='fail'
) }}

with
    sales_order as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__sales_order_header') }}
        {% if is_incremental() %}
        where extracted_at in ({{ var('partitions_to_replace') | join (', ') }})
        {% endif %}
    )

    , sales_order_detail as (
        select *
        from {{ ref('stg_mssql__sales_order_detail') }}
        {% if is_incremental() %}
        where extracted_at in ({{ var('partitions_to_replace') | join (', ') }})
        {% endif %}
    )

    , detailed_sales_orders as (
        /*
        This CTE makes the distribution of the order freight and tax amounts.
        The intention here is to have one general table to all sales orders.
        Since the freight and the tax are values applied to the order itself, we split these values to the product level.
        */
        select
            sales_order_detail.sales_order_id
            , sales_order_detail.sales_order_detail_id
            , sales_order_detail.carrier_tracking_number
            , sales_order_detail.order_qty
            , sales_order_detail.product_id
            , sales_order_detail.special_offer_id
            , sales_order_detail.unit_price
            , sales_order_detail.unit_price_discount
            , sales_order_detail.subtotal
            , sales_order.revision_number
            , sales_order.order_date
            , sales_order.due_date
            , sales_order.ship_date
            , sales_order.order_status
            , sales_order.online_order_flag
            , sales_order.sales_order_number
            , sales_order.purchase_order_number
            , sales_order.account_number
            , sales_order.customer_id
            , sales_order.sales_person_id
            , sales_order.territory_id
            , sales_order.customer_bill_to_address_id
            , sales_order.customer_ship_to_address_id
            , sales_order.ship_method_id
            , sales_order.credit_card_id
            , sales_order.credit_card_approval_code
            , sales_order.currency_rate_id
            , sales_order.tax_amount / count(sales_order_detail.sales_order_id) over (
                partition by sales_order_detail.sales_order_id
                order by sales_order_detail.sales_order_id
            ) as tax_amount
            , sales_order.freight / count(sales_order_detail.sales_order_id) over (
                partition by sales_order_detail.sales_order_id
                order by sales_order_detail.sales_order_id
            ) as freight
            , sales_order_detail.updated_at
            , sales_order_detail.extracted_at
            -- This cast is necessary to match the exact type of contract
            , cast(current_timestamp() as timestamp) as loaded_at
            , sales_order_detail.system_name
        from sales_order_detail
        left join sales_order
            on sales_order_detail.sales_order_id = sales_order.sales_order_id
    )

select *
from detailed_sales_orders

        left join address_type

        left join email_address

        left join person_phone

        left join person_phone_type

model.indimesh_dbt_core_reference.dim_da.name: dim_dates
model.indimesh_dbt_core_reference.dim_da.description: This model contains all the dates starting from 2000-01-01.
model.indimesh_dbt_core_reference.dim_da.raw_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def model(dbt, session):
    dbt.config(
        materialized='table'
    )

    start_date = datetime.strptime(dbt.config.get("start_date", "2000-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%d")
    end_date = datetime.today()

    date_range_df = spark.createDataFrame(
        [(start_date + timedelta(days=i),) for i in range((end_date - start_date).days + 1)],
        ["date_day"]
)

    dim_dates_df = date_range_df.select(
        F.date_format("date_day", "yyyy-MM-dd").cast('date').alias("date_day")
        , F.dayofweek("date_day").alias("day_of_week")
        , F.date_format("date_day", "EEEE").alias("day_name")
        , F.month("date_day").alias("month")
        , F.date_format("date_day", "MMMM").alias("month_name")
        , F.date_format("date_day", "MMM").alias("month_abbrev")
        , F.quarter("date_day").alias("quarter")
        , F.concat(F.lit(F.quarter("date_day")), F.lit("º quarter")).alias("quarter_name")
        , F.when(F.quarter("date_day") <= 2, 1).otherwise(2).alias("semester")
        , F.when(F.quarter("date_day") <= 2, "1º semester").otherwise("2º semester").alias("semester_name")
        , F.dayofyear("date_day").alias("day_of_year")
        , F.year("date_day").alias("year")
    )

    return dim_dates_df

model.elementary.metrics_anomaly_score.raw_code:
{{

    bind=False

with data_monitoring_metrics as (

    select * from {{ ref('data_monitoring_metrics') }}

),

time_window_aggregation as (

    select
        id,
        full_table_name,
        column_name,
        dimension,
        dimension_value,
        metric_name,
        metric_value,
        source_value,
        bucket_start,
        bucket_end,
        bucket_duration_hours,
        updated_at,
        avg(metric_value) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as training_avg,
        stddev(metric_value) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as training_stddev,
        count(metric_value) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as training_set_size,
        last_value(bucket_end) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) training_end,
        first_value(bucket_end) over (partition by metric_name, full_table_name, column_name order by bucket_start asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as training_start
    from data_monitoring_metrics
    {{ dbt_utils.group_by(12) }}
),

metrics_anomaly_score as (

    select
        id,
        full_table_name,
        column_name,
        dimension,
        dimension_value,
        metric_name,
        case
            when training_stddev is null then null
            when training_stddev = 0 then 0
            else (metric_value - training_avg) / (training_stddev)
        end as anomaly_score,
        metric_value as latest_metric_value,
        bucket_start,
        bucket_end,
        training_avg,
        training_stddev,
        training_start,
        training_end,
        training_set_size,
        max(updated_at) as updated_at
    from time_window_aggregation
        where
            metric_value is not null
            and training_avg is not null
            and bucket_end >= {{ elementary.edr_timeadd('day', '-7', elementary.edr_date_trunc('day', elementary.edr_current_timestamp())) }}
    {{ dbt_utils.group_by(15) }}
    order by bucket_end desc


),

final as (

    select
        id,
        full_table_name,
        column_name,
        dimension,
        dimension_value,
        metric_name,
        anomaly_score,
        latest_metric_value,
        bucket_start,
        bucket_end,
        training_avg,
        training_stddev,
        training_start,
        training_end,
        training_set_size,
        updated_at,
        case
            when abs(anomaly_score) > {{ elementary.get_config_var('anomaly_sensitivity') }} then true
            else false end
        as is_anomaly
    from metrics_anomaly_score
)

  sources.tags,
  sources.meta,

  sources.package_name,

databricks__get_catalog_tables_sql
macro.dbt_databricks.databricks__get_cat.macro_sql:
{% macro databricks__get_catalog_tables_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select
        table_catalog as table_database,
        table_schema,
        table_name,
        lower(table_type) as table_type,
        comment as table_comment,
        table_owner,
        'Last Modified' as `stats:last_modified:label`,
        last_altered as `stats:last_modified:value`,
        'The timestamp for last update/change' as `stats:last_modified:description`,
        (last_altered is not null and table_type not ilike '%VIEW%') as `stats:last_modified:include`
    from `system`.`information_schema`.`tables`
    where table_catalog = '{{ information_schema.database|lower }}'
{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt_databricks.databricks__get_cat.name: databricks__get_catalog_columns_sql
macro.dbt_databricks.databricks__get_cat.macro_sql:
{% macro databricks__get_catalog_columns_sql(information_schema) -%}
    select
        table_catalog as table_database,
        table_schema,
        table_name,
        column_name,
        ordinal_position as column_index,
        lower(data_type) as column_type,
        comment as column_comment
    from `system`.`information_schema`.`columns`
    where table_catalog = '{{ information_schema.database|lower }}'
{%- endmacro %}

),

    select
        cast(d.date_day as date) as date_day,
        cast({{ dbt.dateadd('year', -1 , 'd.date_day') }} as date) as prior_year_date_day,
        cast({{ dbt.dateadd('day', -364 , 'd.date_day') }} as date) as prior_year_over_year_date_day
    from
    	base_dates d

)
select
    d.date_day,
    {{ dbt_date.yesterday('d.date_day') }} as prior_date_day,
    {{ dbt_date.tomorrow('d.date_day') }} as next_date_day,
    d.prior_year_date_day as prior_year_date_day,
    d.prior_year_over_year_date_day,
    {{ dbt_date.day_of_week('d.date_day', isoweek=false) }} as day_of_week,

    {{ dbt_date.day_name('d.date_day', short=false) }} as day_of_week_name,
    {{ dbt_date.day_name('d.date_day', short=true) }} as day_of_week_name_short,
    {{ dbt_date.day_of_month('d.date_day') }} as day_of_month,
    {{ dbt_date.day_of_year('d.date_day') }} as day_of_year,

    {{ dbt_date.week_start('d.date_day') }} as week_start_date,
    {{ dbt_date.week_end('d.date_day') }} as week_end_date,
    {{ dbt_date.week_start('d.prior_year_over_year_date_day') }} as prior_year_week_start_date,
    {{ dbt_date.week_end('d.prior_year_over_year_date_day') }} as prior_year_week_end_date,
    {{ dbt_date.week_of_year('d.date_day') }} as week_of_year,

    {{ dbt_date.iso_week_start('d.date_day') }} as iso_week_start_date,
    {{ dbt_date.iso_week_end('d.date_day') }} as iso_week_end_date,
    {{ dbt_date.iso_week_start('d.prior_year_over_year_date_day') }} as prior_year_iso_week_start_date,
    {{ dbt_date.iso_week_end('d.prior_year_over_year_date_day') }} as prior_year_iso_week_end_date,
    {{ dbt_date.iso_week_of_year('d.date_day') }} as iso_week_of_year,

    {{ dbt_date.week_of_year('d.prior_year_over_year_date_day') }} as prior_year_week_of_year,
    {{ dbt_date.iso_week_of_year('d.prior_year_over_year_date_day') }} as prior_year_iso_week_of_year,

    cast({{ dbt_date.date_part('month', 'd.date_day') }} as {{ dbt.type_int() }}) as month_of_year,
    {{ dbt_date.month_name('d.date_day', short=false) }}  as month_name,
    {{ dbt_date.month_name('d.date_day', short=true) }}  as month_name_short,

    cast({{ dbt.date_trunc('month', 'd.date_day') }} as date) as month_start_date,
    cast({{ last_day('d.date_day', 'month') }} as date) as month_end_date,

    cast({{ dbt.date_trunc('month', 'd.prior_year_date_day') }} as date) as prior_year_month_start_date,
    cast({{ last_day('d.prior_year_date_day', 'month') }} as date) as prior_year_month_end_date,

    cast({{ dbt_date.date_part('quarter', 'd.date_day') }} as {{ dbt.type_int() }}) as quarter_of_year,
    cast({{ dbt.date_trunc('quarter', 'd.date_day') }} as date) as quarter_start_date,

    cast({{ dbt_date.date_part('year', 'd.date_day') }} as {{ dbt.type_int() }}) as year_number,
    cast({{ dbt.date_trunc('year', 'd.date_day') }} as date) as year_start_date,
    cast({{ last_day('d.date_day', 'year') }} as date) as year_end_date
from

-- this gets all the dates within a fiscal year
-- determined by the given year-end-month
-- ending on the saturday closest to that month's end date
with fsc_date_dimension as (
    select * from {{ dates }}
),
year_month_end as (

    select
       d.year_number - {{ shift_year }} as fiscal_year_number,
       d.month_end_date
    from
        fsc_date_dimension d
    where
        d.month_of_year = {{ year_end_month }}
    group by 1,2

),
weeks as (

    select
        d.year_number,
        d.month_of_year,
        d.date_day as week_start_date,
        cast({{ dbt.dateadd('day', 6, 'd.date_day') }} as date) as week_end_date
    from
        fsc_date_dimension d
    where
        d.day_of_week = {{ week_start_day }}

),
-- get all the weeks that start in the month the year ends
year_week_ends as (

    select
        d.year_number - {{ shift_year }} as fiscal_year_number,
        d.week_end_date
    from
        weeks d
    where
        d.month_of_year = {{ year_end_month }}
    group by
        1,2

),
-- then calculate which Saturday is closest to month end
weeks_at_month_end as (

    select
        d.fiscal_year_number,
        d.week_end_date,
        m.month_end_date,
        rank() over
            (partition by d.fiscal_year_number
                order by
                abs({{ dbt.datediff('d.week_end_date', 'm.month_end_date', 'day') }})

            ) as closest_to_month_end
    from
        year_week_ends d
        join
        year_month_end m on d.fiscal_year_number = m.fiscal_year_number
),
fiscal_year_range as (

    select
        w.fiscal_year_number,
        cast(
            {{ dbt.dateadd('day', 1,
            'lag(w.week_end_date) over(order by w.week_end_date)') }}
            as date) as fiscal_year_start_date,
        w.week_end_date as fiscal_year_end_date
    from
        weeks_at_month_end w
    where
        w.closest_to_month_end = 1

),
fiscal_year_dates as (

    select
        d.date_day,
        m.fiscal_year_number,
        m.fiscal_year_start_date,
        m.fiscal_year_end_date,
        w.week_start_date,
        w.week_end_date,
        -- we reset the weeks of the year starting with the merch year start date
        dense_rank()
            over(
                partition by m.fiscal_year_number
                order by w.week_start_date
                ) as fiscal_week_of_year
    from
        fsc_date_dimension d
        join
        fiscal_year_range m on d.date_day between m.fiscal_year_start_date and m.fiscal_year_end_date
        join
        weeks w on d.date_day between w.week_start_date and w.week_end_date

)
select * from fiscal_year_dates order by 1
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_date.get_fiscal_periods.name: get_fiscal_periods
macro.dbt_date.get_fiscal_periods.macro_sql:
{% macro get_fiscal_periods(dates, year_end_month, week_start_day, shift_year=1) %}
{#
This macro requires you to pass in a ref to a date dimension, created via
dbt_date.get_date_dimension()s
#}
with fscl_year_dates_for_periods as (
    {{ dbt_date.get_fiscal_year_dates(dates, year_end_month, week_start_day, shift_year) }}
),
fscl_year_w13 as (

    select
        f.*,
        -- We count the weeks in a 13 week period
        -- and separate the 4-5-4 week sequences
        mod(cast(
            (f.fiscal_week_of_year-1) as {{ dbt.type_int() }}
            ), 13) as w13_number,
        -- Chop weeks into 13 week merch quarters
        cast(
            least(
                floor((f.fiscal_week_of_year-1)/13.0)
                , 3)
            as {{ dbt.type_int() }}) as quarter_number
    from
        fscl_year_dates_for_periods f

),
fscl_periods as (

    select
        f.date_day,
        f.fiscal_year_number,
        f.week_start_date,
        f.week_end_date,
        f.fiscal_week_of_year,
        case
            -- we move week 53 into the 3rd period of the quarter
            when f.fiscal_week_of_year = 53 then 3
            when f.w13_number between 0 and 3 then 1
            when f.w13_number between 4 and 8 then 2
            when f.w13_number between 9 and 12 then 3
        end as period_of_quarter,
        f.quarter_number
    from
        fscl_year_w13 f

),
fscl_periods_quarters as (

    select
        f.*,
        cast((
            (f.quarter_number * 3) + f.period_of_quarter
         ) as {{ dbt.type_int() }}) as fiscal_period_number
    from
        fscl_periods f

)
select
    date_day,
    fiscal_year_number,
    week_start_date,
    week_end_date,
    fiscal_week_of_year,
    dense_rank() over(partition by fiscal_period_number order by fiscal_week_of_year) as fiscal_week_of_period,
    fiscal_period_number,
    quarter_number+1 as fiscal_quarter_number,
    period_of_quarter as fiscal_period_of_quarter
from
    fscl_periods_quarters
order by 1,2
{% endmacro %}

macro.indicium_dbt_utils.create_sample_s.description:
This macro creates a sample of a source using the arguments of sample size and partition, returning the source with the number of partitions in a descending order. It will create a table with the prefix sample_ inside your dev schema. The best aproach is to use a sample in cases where the table is too big (like 5m more rows) to use it full to develop. Think always in combine both a good size of sample and speed development, you should find a configuration that works for your demand.
To create the samples you should add the sources tables you want to sample in the samples_to_create.json file. You just have to add the source name, table name, partition column and sample size, as the folowing example:
["raw_sales", "salesorderheader", "extraction_date", 90, "HOUR/DAY"]
You can find the samples_to_create.json in the root of the project and you can add more samples if you want, as long as you have in mind the aproach mentioned above.
After you specified the samples in the samples_to_create.json, you have to run the command "bash create_sample_script.sh" in your Command Line Interface (CLI).

arguments.name: source_name
arguments.description: The name of source that you want to create a sample

arguments.name: table_name
arguments.description: The model name of source that you want to create a sample

arguments.name: partition_column
arguments.description: The column name of partition of table, try to use a column that fits the demand

{% test expect_column_values_to_be_within_n_moving_stdevs(model,
                                  column_name,

macro.dbt_expectations.default__test_exp.name: default__test_expect_column_values_to_be_within_n_moving_stdevs
macro.dbt_expectations.default__test_exp.macro_sql:
{% macro default__test_expect_column_values_to_be_within_n_moving_stdevs(model,
                                  column_name,
                                  date_column_name,
                                  group_by,
                                  period,
                                  lookback_periods,
                                  trend_periods,
                                  test_periods,
                                  sigma_threshold,
                                  sigma_threshold_upper,
                                  sigma_threshold_lower,
                                  take_diffs,
                                  take_logs
                                ) %}

{%- set sigma_threshold_upper = sigma_threshold_upper if sigma_threshold_upper else sigma_threshold -%}
{%- set sigma_threshold_lower = sigma_threshold_lower if sigma_threshold_lower else -1 * sigma_threshold -%}
{%- set partition_by = "partition by " ~ (group_by | join(",")) if group_by -%}
{%- set group_by_length = (group_by | length ) if group_by else 0 -%}

with metric_values as (

    with grouped_metric_values as (

        select
            {{ dbt.date_trunc(period, date_column_name) }} as metric_period,
            {{ group_by | join(",") ~ "," if group_by }}
            sum({{ column_name }}) as agg_metric_value
        from
            {{ model }}
        {{  dbt_expectations.group_by(1 + group_by_length) }}

    )
    {%- if take_diffs %}
    , grouped_metric_values_with_priors as (

        select
            *,
            lag(agg_metric_value, {{ lookback_periods }}) over(
                {{ partition_by }}
                order by metric_period) as prior_agg_metric_value
    from
        grouped_metric_values d

    )
    select
        *,
        {{ dbt_expectations._get_metric_expression("agg_metric_value", take_logs) }}
        -
        {{ dbt_expectations._get_metric_expression("prior_agg_metric_value", take_logs) }}
        as metric_test_value
    from
        grouped_metric_values_with_priors d

    {%- else %}

    select
        *,
        {{ dbt_expectations._get_metric_expression("agg_metric_value", take_logs) }}
        as metric_test_value
    from
        grouped_metric_values

    {%- endif %}

),
metric_moving_calcs as (

    select
        *,
        avg(metric_test_value)
            over({{ partition_by }}
                    order by metric_period rows
                    between {{ trend_periods }} preceding and 1 preceding) as metric_test_rolling_average,
        stddev(metric_test_value)
            over({{ partition_by }}
                    order by metric_period rows
                    between {{ trend_periods }} preceding and 1 preceding) as metric_test_rolling_stddev
    from
        metric_values

),
metric_sigma as (

    select
        *,
        (metric_test_value - metric_test_rolling_average) as metric_test_delta,
        (metric_test_value - metric_test_rolling_average)/
            nullif(metric_test_rolling_stddev, 0) as metric_test_sigma
    from
        metric_moving_calcs

)
select
    *
from
    metric_sigma
where

    metric_period >= cast(
            {{ dbt.dateadd(period, -test_periods, dbt.date_trunc(period, dbt_date.now())) }}
            as {{ dbt_expectations.type_timestamp() }})
    and
    metric_period < {{ dbt.date_trunc(period, dbt_date.now()) }}
    and

    not (
        metric_test_sigma >= {{ sigma_threshold_lower }} and
        metric_test_sigma <= {{ sigma_threshold_upper }}
    )
{%- endmacro -%}

macro.elementary.get_columns_changes_que.macro_sql:
{% macro get_columns_changes_query_generic(full_table_name, cur, pre, include_added=True) %}
    {%- set test_execution_id = elementary.get_test_execution_id() %}
    {%- set test_unique_id = elementary.get_test_unique_id() %}

    with cur as (
        {{ cur }}
    ),

    pre as (
        {{ pre }}
    ),

    type_changes as (

        {# Finding the columns that have changed type. #}
        select
            cur.full_table_name,
            'type_changed' as change,
            cur.column_name,
            cur.data_type as data_type,
            pre.data_type as pre_data_type,
            pre.detected_at
        from cur inner join pre
            on (lower(cur.full_table_name) = lower(pre.full_table_name) and lower(cur.column_name) = lower(pre.column_name))
        where pre.data_type IS NOT NULL AND lower(cur.data_type) != lower(pre.data_type)

    ),

    {% if include_added %}
    columns_added as (

        {# This is the columns that have been added. #}
        select
            full_table_name,
            'column_added' as change,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            {{ elementary.null_string() }} as pre_data_type,
            detected_at as detected_at
        from cur
        where is_new = true

    ),
    {% endif %}

    columns_removed as (

        {# This is finding the columns that have been removed. #}
        select
            pre.full_table_name,
            'column_removed' as change,
            pre.column_name as column_name,
            {{ elementary.null_string() }} as data_type,
            pre.data_type as pre_data_type,
            pre.detected_at as detected_at
        from pre left join cur
            on (lower(cur.full_table_name) = lower(pre.full_table_name) and lower(cur.column_name) = lower(pre.column_name))
        where cur.full_table_name is null and cur.column_name is null

    ),

    columns_removed_filter_deleted_tables as (

        {# This is filtering out the columns of tables that have been deleted. #}
        select
            removed.full_table_name,
            removed.change,
            removed.column_name,
            removed.data_type,
            removed.pre_data_type,
            removed.detected_at
        from columns_removed as removed join cur
            on (lower(removed.full_table_name) = lower(cur.full_table_name))

    ),

    all_column_changes as (

        {# Combining the results of the three queries into one table. #}
        select * from type_changes
        union all
        select * from columns_removed_filter_deleted_tables
        {% if include_added %}
        union all
        select * from columns_added
        {% endif %}
    ),

    column_changes_test_results as (

        {# This is the query that is creating the test results table, by formatting a description and adding id + detection time #}
        select
            {{ elementary.generate_surrogate_key([
                'full_table_name',
                'column_name',
                'change',
                'detected_at',
            ]) }} as data_issue_id,
            {{ elementary.datetime_now_utc_as_timestamp_column() }} as detected_at,
            {{ elementary.full_name_split('database_name') }},
            {{ elementary.full_name_split('schema_name') }},
            {{ elementary.full_name_split('table_name') }},
            column_name,
            'schema_change' as test_type,
            change as test_sub_type,
            case
                when change = 'column_added'
                    then 'The column "' || column_name || '" was added'
                when change= 'column_removed'
                    then 'The column "' || column_name || '" was removed'
                when change= 'type_changed'
                    then 'The type of "' || column_name || '" was changed from ' || pre_data_type || ' to ' || data_type
                else NULL
            end as test_results_description
        from all_column_changes
        {{ dbt_utils.group_by(9) }}

    )

        {# Creating a unique id for each row in the table, and adding execution id #}
    select {{ elementary.generate_surrogate_key([
                     'data_issue_id',
                     elementary.const_as_string(test_execution_id)
                ]) }} as id,
        {{ elementary.const_as_string(test_execution_id) }} as test_execution_id,
        {{ elementary.const_as_string(test_unique_id) }} as test_unique_id,
        *
    from column_changes_test_results

{%- endmacro %}

macro.elementary.get_columns_snapshot_qu.name: get_columns_snapshot_query
macro.elementary.get_columns_snapshot_qu.macro_sql:
{% macro get_columns_snapshot_query(model_relation, full_table_name) %}
    {%- set schema_columns_snapshot_relation = elementary.get_elementary_relation('schema_columns_snapshot') %}
    {%- set known_columns_query %}
        select full_column_name from {{ schema_columns_snapshot_relation }}
        where detected_at = (select max(detected_at) from {{ schema_columns_snapshot_relation }} where lower(full_table_name) = lower('{{ full_table_name }}'))
        and lower(full_table_name) = lower('{{ full_table_name }}')
    {% endset %}

    {%- set known_tables_query %}
        select distinct full_table_name from {{ schema_columns_snapshot_relation }}
        where detected_at = (select max(detected_at) from {{ schema_columns_snapshot_relation }} where lower(full_table_name) = lower('{{ full_table_name }}'))
        and lower(full_table_name) = lower('{{ full_table_name }}')
    {% endset %}

    {% set columns = adapter.get_columns_in_relation(model_relation) %}

    with table_info as (
        select
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(full_table_name)) }} as full_table_name,
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(model_relation.database)) }} as database_name,
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(model_relation.schema)) }} as schema_name,
            {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(model_relation.identifier)) }} as table_name,
            {{ elementary.datetime_now_utc_as_timestamp_column() }} as detected_at
    ),

    columns_info as (
        select
            full_table_name,
            database_name,
            schema_name,
            table_name,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            detected_at
        from table_info
        cross join
            (
                {% for column in columns %}
                    select
                        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(column.name)) }} as column_name,
                        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string(elementary.edr_quote(elementary.get_normalized_data_type(elementary.get_column_data_type(column)))) }} as data_type
                    {% if not loop.last %}
                        union all
                    {% endif %}
                {% endfor %}
            ) rt
    ),

    columns_snapshot as (
        select
            full_table_name,
            database_name,
            schema_name,
            table_name,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            detected_at,
            case when
                    {{ elementary.full_column_name() }} not in ({{ known_columns_query }})
                    and full_table_name in ({{ known_tables_query }})
                then true
                else false
            end as is_new
        from columns_info
    ),

    columns_snapshot_with_id as (
        select
            {{ elementary.generate_surrogate_key([
              'full_table_name',
              'column_name',
              'data_type',
            ]) }} as column_state_id,
            {{ elementary.full_column_name() }} as full_column_name,
            full_table_name,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            is_new,
            detected_at
        from columns_snapshot
        group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
    )

    select
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('column_state_id') }} as column_state_id,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('full_column_name') }} as full_column_name,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('full_table_name') }} as full_table_name,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('column_name') }} as column_name,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_string('data_type') }} as data_type,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_bool('is_new') }} as is_new,
        {{ elementary.edr_cast_as_timestamp('detected_at') }} as detected_at
    from columns_snapshot_with_id

{%- endmacro %}
